title: BTC-ETH support reclaim with leverage unwind resets reversal risk to no edge
hypothesis: After a failed-breakout reversal-risk state, two or more completed 15-minute BTC closes above the predeclared support combined with falling contract open interest and ETH recovery should reset the stale reversal label to NO_EDGE, without automatically restoring a long bias.
mechanism: BTC reclaimed 85,900 and held above it across multiple completed 15-minute observations while OKX BTC contract open interest fell about 1.87% from the failed-breakout snapshot and ETH recovered. This matches the prior packet's explicit NO_EDGE condition: leverage fell while price returned to the prior range. Because BTC remains below the original breakout snapshot, OI remains about 1.17% above that original level, and taker-flow, breadth, liquidation and cross-exchange confirmation are absent, the evidence cancels reversal risk but does not re-establish trend continuation.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: Paper-only state-transition detector. Given a prior FAILED_BREAKOUT_OI_REBUILD state with support S, set REVERSAL_RISK_CANCELLED = close_15m[-2] > S AND close_15m[-1] > S AND OI_contract_now/OI_contract_failed_breakout - 1 <= -0.015 AND BTC_price_now > BTC_price_failed_breakout AND ETH_price_now > ETH_price_failed_breakout. Set regime=NO_EDGE and expected_trade_expression=NEUTRAL. Restore conditional TREND_UP only if BTC also recovers the original breakout reference, ETH remains positive, and at least one independent confirmation passes: taker_buy_ratio_5m >= rolling_30d_q67, breadth_positive_share_top50_5m >= rolling_30d_q67, or bid_microprice_pressure_z >= 1. Do not open, close, reverse, resize, delay, suppress, or route a live order from this state.
required_data: Point-in-time BTC and ETH perpetual prices
Completed one-minute or 15-minute BTC candles with finality flags
Prospectively timestamped BTC contract open interest with firstObservedAt and ingestedAt
Funding rate and perpetual premium/index basis
Taker flow, top-50 breadth, L2 depth/microprice and liquidation stream for independent confirmation
Original breakout and failed-breakout state snapshots, timestamps and support level
transaction_cost_implications: A state reset can prevent repeated execution of a stale reversal or continuation narrative, but NO_EDGE must not be treated as a free veto. Offline tests must separately price unchanged-baseline, score-reset, same-side rotation and hard-veto shadow arms using actual fee tier, funding, Q-sized book walk, missed-move cost and 1.5x/2x slippage stress.
expected_benefit: Reduce whipsaw from persisting with a reversal label after leverage unwinds and support is causally reclaimed, while preserving trade frequency by resetting confidence rather than forcing an opposite-side trade or mandatory skip.
risks: Evidence is concentrated on OKX; Binance endpoints were inaccessible in the research environment. The OI observation was less fresh than the latest price snapshot. Falling OI with rising price can be short covering rather than durable demand. BTC had not recovered the original breakout reference and no taker, breadth, liquidation, full-depth or reliable Polymarket probability-velocity confirmation was available. A range reset can miss a renewed directional move.
falsification_criteria: REJECT if the reset does not improve matched-frequency net PnL, profit factor or maximum drawdown in both locked OOS periods; if benefit disappears under 1.5x costs; if retained trade count falls below 98%; if a price-only two-close reclaim performs equally well and OI unwind adds no incremental value; if prospective point-in-time OI does not reproduce the relation; or if results depend on fewer than five independent event clusters.
validation_plan: Use only observations with usableAt<=decision_time. Develop on 2024-2025, validate unchanged on January-June 2026, and use July-September 2026 once as a locked historical test only where OI time semantics are verified. Freeze the detector and run at least 90 future paper days. Compare STALE_REVERSAL, PRICE_ONLY_RECLAIM, PRICE_X_OI_UNWIND_RESET, PRICE_X_ETH_RESET, FULL_NO_EDGE_RESET, SAME_SIDE_ROTATION, HARD_VETO_SHADOW and matched-frequency random resets. Report net PnL, profit factor, maximum drawdown, MAE/MFE, retention, trade count, capital utilization, implementation shortfall and 1.5x/2x cost sensitivity with day/event-block bootstrap.
minimum_sample: At least 200 failed-breakout states, 75 two-close support reclaims, 50 reclaims with OI unwind of at least 1.5%, 500 eligible baseline decisions, five independent event clusters and at least 90 prospective calendar days; extend until all counts are met.

primary_drivers: short-term price recovery without flow confirmation
BTC remains below the original breakout snapshot

contradictions: BTC reclaimed and held 85,900, but remained below the original 86,570.5 breakout snapshot.
BTC contract OI fell about 1.87% from the failed-breakout snapshot but remained about 1.17% above the original breakout snapshot.
Funding was positive and modest while premium remained negative.
ETH recovered with BTC, but no taker-flow, breadth, liquidation, full-depth or Polymarket probability-change confirmation was available.
invalidation_triggers: Return to REVERSAL_RISK if BTC completes a 15-minute close below 85,900 and fails the next completed reclaim while OI rises at least 2% from the reset snapshot.
Upgrade only to conditional TREND_UP if BTC recovers the original breakout area near 86,570, ETH confirms, and breadth, taker flow or microprice provides an independent positive signal.
Escalate toward TREND_DOWN only if BTC breaks the rolling 24-hour open/low with negative breadth and sell-flow or liquidation confirmation.
Keep NO_EDGE if price remains inside the prior range and OI/funding/order-flow evidence stays mixed.

polymarket_context.liquidity_spread_oi_volume_observations: No trustworthy point-in-time probability and market-quality series was available for this reset.
polymarket_context.reliability_notes: Polymarket was excluded rather than treated as confirmation.

derivatives_context.observations: The predeclared reversal-risk cancellation condition was met on completed one-minute data aggregated into consecutive 15-minute observations: BTC reclaimed and held above 85,900. OI simultaneously unwound materially from the failed-breakout snapshot, while BTC and ETH recovered. This cancels REVERSAL_RISK but does not prove renewed trend continuation.

macro_news_context: No new official macro or regulatory catalyst was used. This is a market-structure state reset, and the absence of an independent event catalyst caps confidence.
